articles.title: Bitcoin's $19 billion wake-up call: One-year after flash crash, has crypto learned anything?
articles.snippet: The Oct. 10, 2025 flash crash wiped out billions in leveraged crypto bets. Traders now have better tools to spot risks, but the forces behind the selloff remain.

articles.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
articles.snippet: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.

articles.title: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
articles.snippet: The technical trial showed how AI agents could discover services and make micropayments using HSBC’s tokenized deposits, with real-time settlement and risk checks.

articles.title: Ledger investigates fund losses linked to Southeast Asian reseller, warns users
articles.snippet: Hardware wallet maker Ledger probes losses tied to reseller CryptoBilis, as researchers separately estimate more than $72 million to $86 million in suspected crypto thefts.

articles.title: France is world’s most dangerous place for Bitcoiners: 90 attacks in 7 months
articles.snippet: French authorities recorded 90 crypto-related cases involving kidnapping, extortion, threats and violent theft in seven months. What makes France such a hotspot?
